removedRoutes.reason: WAVE 97B · R86 — A SIGNATURE-VERIFYING WEBHOOK ENDPOINT FOR A PAYMENT PROVIDER THE PLATFORM DOES NOT USE, REMOVED ON THE OWNER'S DIRECT INSTRUCTION. This route was registered by the SACRED file server/paymentGatewayAdapter.ts (was :1199) and called handleGatewayWebhook("stripe"), which HMAC-verified the body with verifyStripeSig from server/lib/stripeGateway.ts and then dispatched into the subscription/payment/invoice machinery. The platform has routed every payment through Airwallex since v25.4 (11-Jun-2026, Ozan's directive), so this endpoint could only ever have accepted traffic for a provider that is not in use. IT WAS ALREADY UNREACHABLE IN THE RUNNING APP, WHICH IS PART OF WHY REMOVING IT IS SAFE: a PRE-EXISTING v25.6 middleware, deprecateStripeFounderWebhook in server/lib/founderBillingExtensions.ts:79, is registered BEFORE registerPaymentGatewayRoutes() and answers this exact path with a permanent 410 {error:"gateway_deprecated", migration:"airwallex"}. That 410 TOMBSTONE IS DELIBERATELY KEPT and is not part of this removal — it is the stop signal that tells an operator's old dashboard webhook to reconfigure to /api/webhooks/payment-gateway/airwallex, and replacing it with a silent 404 would be strictly worse for an operator. So what actually disappeared is the shadowed handler behind the tombstone, not the response an integrator sees. NOTHING IS LOST: the equivalent live endpoint POST /api/webhooks/payment-gateway/airwallex is unchanged, still registered by the same sacred registrar, still verified by verifyAirwallexSig, still idempotent on (intentId, type), and still fails CLOSED in production when the gateway is unconfigured. RESTORING THIS ROUTE IS NOT AN OPTION while Stripe is not in use: it would re-mount an authentication surface for an unused provider, which is the same reasoning already accepted for the fabricated /api/admin/pricing endpoints in removedRoutes above — restoring it would restore an attack surface, not a function. ENFORCED BY: server/__tests__/w97b_stripe_gone_and_seam.test.ts (the path reaches no gateway and no payment is dispatched; the Airwallex route still answers 200; the sacred adapter's source carries no stripe registration and no verifyStripeSig call) and the rewritten describe block in server/__tests__/airwallexGateway.test.ts (a bare adapter app returns 404 for this path, proving the handler itself is gone rather than merely shadowed). SACRED RECORD: the edit is registered as the WAVE 97B RE-FREEZE of the EXISTING WAIVER-8 row in scripts/sacred_check.sh; npm run sacred reads 48/48 with NINE ratified waivers, unchanged, because no row was added. FULL DETAIL: build_log/wave97b/W97B_REMOVAL.md and W97B_SACRED_REFREEZE.md.

removedCopy.reason: WAVES 114 AND 116 · A MONEY LABEL REMOVED BECAUSE THE FIGURE BENEATH IT WAS FALSE, NOT BECAUSE THE PANEL WAS SIMPLIFIED. Wave 114 established by exhaustive search that the rounds.raised_amount column is NEVER WRITTEN ANYWHERE IN THE CODEBASE — it exists only as reads plus a schema default of zero — so every surface reading it printed a permanent $0 regardless of how much a company had actually raised. Ozan saw this himself on his own founder dashboard, which read "RAISED THIS YEAR $0 of $53.7M target" while real money was on the book. THE FIGURE IS NOW DERIVED, NOT STORED: server/lib/roundRaisedTotals.ts computes it from the soft-circle book and the committed ledger, and shared/roundMoneyOnRecordView.ts is the one client-safe reader, so there is no second implementation. THE LABELS HAD TO CHANGE WITH THE ARITHMETIC, which is the whole reason these removals exist: a single "Raised" or "Total raised" caption cannot honestly cover three different business facts, and this platform had been conflating them. A soft circle is an indication of interest, a commitment is a signed obligation, and funded money is cash received. Each is now labelled separately and distinctly — the replacement copy says "Subscribed (committed + funded)" with an explicit basis line, and the progress caption reads "What is on record for your live round, by state". So MORE information is rendered after these removals than before, not less. Where the figure genuinely cannot be derived the surface now refuses with a sentence (no_rows_on_record, mixed_currency) and prints NO NUMBER, because a confident $0 that actually means "unknown" is a false statement about money. RESTORING THESE STRINGS IS NOT AN OPTION: it would reattach an honest caption to a dishonest number. ENFORCED BY: the w114_* and w116_* test files, including a founder-dashboard render proving a company with a real book shows a NON-ZERO figure and a company with nothing on record shows a sentence rather than $0. Ozan saw this himself on his own founder dashboard, which read "RAISED THIS YEAR $0 of $53.7M target" while real money was on the book. THE FIGURE IS NOW DERIVED, NOT STORED: server/lib/roundRaisedTotals.ts computes it from the soft-circle book and the committed ledger, and shared/roundMoneyOnRecordView.ts is the one client-safe reader, so there is no second implementation. THE LABELS HAD TO CHANGE WITH THE ARITHMETIC, which is the whole reason these removals exist: a single "Raised" or "Total raised" caption cannot honestly cover three different business facts, and this platform had been conflating them. A soft circle is an indication of interest, a commitment is a signed obligation, and funded money is cash received. Each is now labelled separately and distinctly — the replacement copy says "Subscribed (committed + funded)" with an explicit basis line, and the progress caption reads "What is on record for your live round, by state". So MORE information is rendered after these removals than before, not less. Where the figure genuinely cannot be derived the surface now refuses with a sentence (no_rows_on_record, mixed_currency) and prints NO NUMBER, because a confident $0 that actually means "unknown" is a false statement about money. RESTORING THESE STRINGS IS NOT AN OPTION: it would reattach an honest caption to a dishonest number. ENFORCED BY: the w114_* and w116_* test files, including a founder-dashboard render proving a company with a real book shows a NON-ZERO figure and a company with nothing on record shows a sentence rather than $0. FULL DETAIL: build_log/wave114/ and build_log/wave116/.

removedCopy.reason: WAVE 122 · FINDING 1 — A MONEY CAPTION REMOVED BECAUSE THE FIGURE IT CAPTIONED WAS FALSE ON EVERY REAL ROUND. `rounds.raised_amount` is declared NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, is inserted as the literal 0 (server/roundsStore.ts:278,326) and is EXCLUDED from the accepted patch keys of the round-terms route (server/routes.ts:7773, `k !== "raisedAmount"`), so NOTHING IN THE PRODUCT WRITES IT — the same column Wave 114 proved has no writer on the founder side. Both investor-facing projections published it anyway (server/routes.ts:4262 LIST and :4371 DETAIL, `raisedAmount: round?.raisedAmount ?? 0`), so an invited investor read "$0 soft-circled of $5M · 0%" above an empty progress bar that could never fill, on the two screens they use immediately before deciding whether to wire money. THE FIGURE IS NOW DERIVED, NOT STORED, BY THE EXISTING SHARED DERIVATION — server/lib/roundRaisedTotals.ts via the in-scope roundMoneyOnRecordForRound helper, read in the browser through the one client-safe reader shared/roundMoneyOnRecordView.ts. No sixth committed register was created; the founder screens and these two investor screens now read the SAME projection, and a test asserts the two payloads carry an identical `source` token. THE CAPTION HAD TO CHANGE WITH THE ARITHMETIC, which is the whole reason this removal exists: the single word "soft-circled" cannot honestly cover three different business facts, and this platform had been conflating them. A soft circle is a non-binding indication of interest, a commitment is a signed obligation, and funded money is cash received. All three are now printed SEPARATELY, each next to its own label from ROUND_MONEY_STATE_LABEL, and the headline reads "… subscribed (committed + funded)", so MORE information reaches the investor after this removal than before, not less. Where the total cannot be derived the screen prints the server's SENTENCE and NO NUMBER (no_rows_on_record / mixed_currency), and the progress bar element is NOT RENDERED AT ALL rather than drawn at 0% — an empty bar is a false statement drawn as a picture. RESTORING THIS STRING IS NOT AN OPTION: it would reattach an honest caption to a structurally impossible number. ENFORCED BY: server/__tests__/w122_investor_round_money_and_currency.test.ts (a round with a real €450,000 book yields a non-zero labelled figure and progressBp 2250; an empty round yields a refusal, no buckets and a null ratio; both payloads agree) and client/src/pages/investor/__tests__/w122_investor_money_and_currency.test.tsx (the rendered screens show the new copy, and NO progress-bar element exists when the figure is underivable). FULL DETAIL: build_log/wave122/W122_PREFLIGHT.md and build_log/wave122/W122_TESTS.md. The panel STRUCTURE was NOT dropped: the Round-target card still renders its four positional div children in the same order (Wave 116's remedy, W116_TESTS.md §3.1) and the three panel-body items the guard first reported were RESTORED, not allowlisted. THIS SITE: client/src/pages/investor/Invitations.tsx, the invitation card on the investor's invitations list. OLD COPY: "{fmtUSD(i.raisedAmount, {compact:true})}" followed by the text node " soft-circled of {fmtUSD(i.targetAmount)}" beside "{fmtPct(pct, 0)}", where `pct = (i.raisedAmount / i.targetAmount) * 100` — a division of the writer-less column, therefore a permanent 0%. NEW COPY: "{subscribedDisplay} subscribed (committed + funded) of {target}", plus "{barPct}% of target subscribed" ONLY when a ratio is derived, plus the three labelled state figures ("€50,000 Soft-circled", "€150,000 Committed", "€300,000 Funded"), or — when nothing is on record — the server's refusal sentence with no figure and no bar.
